task: Post-event estimate of summed reported household members in FEMA flood-damage registration records
model: Random forest of rates scaled by already-reported registration counts
validation: Fixed random 75/25 split of ZIP areas within Harvey; three-fold cross-fitting for map estimates
limitations: Post-event registrations are required; this does not predict a future storm.
The target is summed household members in registration records, not verified distinct affected people or users of any service.
Households without registrations, unmatched geocodes and missing household sizes are incompletely represented.
Flood damage is an observed proxy for cleanup priority, not a cleanup request or injury label.
Nearby ZIPs may be in both train and test; this is not independent-storm or spatial holdout validation.
Cooling, community and health service participation percentages in the GUI are user assumptions, not learned labels.
